projects.title: Urban Pulse
projects.description:
Founded in 2008, as a result of the extensive experience of its founders with leading precast production companies in Italy, I.XH.E.M PRECAST specializes in reinforced concrete constructions, maximizing the material's performance through prestressing technology.

After following our work for years in branding well-known companies, I.XH.E.M entrusted us with the rebranding of their company. With great enthusiasm, we undertook the task of recreating the brand's visual identity, accurately reflecting what they offer: quality, innovation and professionalism.
